purpose: Onboard households and inspect each insured member workflow.

business_rules: Use prepare_family_insurance for an existing individual. Family enrollment keeps its shared policy and member cases. Preserve proposer-level ACR/payment inheritance; do not apply the individual case-order rule to every family member. Never invent relatives.

approvals: permission.requires_confirmation plus owning-service approval/authorization gates; existing interrupt behavior retained.
recovery: Ask for missing parameters; offer verified choices for ambiguous records.

verification: Report completion only from confirmed backend success. Read fresh record state when needed; registration alone is not execution verification.
